rows.text: So this is what the prophecy was pointing to? How unexpected.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Its edges are relatively smooth and doesn't seem to have been damaged by external force. It appears like it deliberately been made to be this way.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: In any case, the prophecy has led us here, so this must be of some use. Please, my esteemed guest, keep it first.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: I still have many unsolved prophecies to decipher. Once we've completed them all, we can investigate the deeper meaning behind them.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker
